verdict.rationale: Penpot documents automation surfaces: an MCP server, a plugin API, outbound webhooks and an RPC API. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to version, review, or roll back those automations. Restoring a deleted main component from a copy is a design-asset recovery feature, not automation version control, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
